Context: None

Question: Miniature poodles are thought to have a mean height of 12 inches and a standard deviation of 1.8 inches. If height is measured to the nearest inch, find the percentage of poodles having a height exceeding 14 inches.

Options: 
A. 45 percent
B. 2.5 percent
C. 5 percent
D. 30 percent
E. 20 percent
F. 10 percent
G. 15 percent
H. 35 percent
I. 40 percent
J. 25 percent

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
